input.summary: Confirm the Company may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' amounts payable under Section 3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have confirmed that the Company's 90-day termination right in Section 4.1 may be exercised at any time (not only as a non-renewal), limited HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term so it cannot walk away mid-term, and capped the Termination Payment at three months of the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice

ops.text: Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term, and any Termination Date specified in HDI's notice shall be the last day of that term.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the amounts payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
